# 1. Problem 4.12

## data import
```{r}
income <- read_table("Income.dat.txt")
head(income)
```

## (a)
```{r}
ggplot(income, aes(x = income, y = race, fill = race)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    x = "Annual Income (thousands of dollars)",
    y = "Race"
  )
```

## (b) parameters
```{r}
black <- income$income[income$race == "B"]
white <- income$income[income$race == "W"]

n_B <- length(black)
n_W <- length(white)

mean_B <- mean(black)
mean_W <- mean(white)

sd_B <- sd(black)
sd_W <- sd(white)

n_B
n_W
mean_B
mean_W
sd_B
sd_W
```

## (c)
```{r}
black <- income$income[income$race == "B"]
white <- income$income[income$race == "W"]

t.test(black, white,
       conf.level = 0.90,
       var.equal = FALSE)
```

# 2. Problem 4.14

## data import
```{r}
students <- read_table("Students.dat.txt")
head(students)
```

## (b)
```{r}
female <- students$tv[students$gender == 0]
male <- students$tv[students$gender == 1]

length(female)
length(male)
mean(female)
mean(male)
sd(female)
sd(male)

t.test(female, male,
       conf.level = 0.95,
       var.equal = FALSE)
```
